purpose: Fresh chronological transfer evaluation frozen before scoring
rationale: Established Python projects with real linked issue history, manageable source size and no previous scoring in this project. Local user repositories are inventoried for future integration checks; Go/TypeScript require a different historical function mapper than this Python-only mining pipeline.
split: Chronological by fix commit; last 40 percent held out; reject duplicate tickets, commits or normalized exact queries across split
selection: Keep both results regardless of score or insufficient sample. No substitutes selected based on outcomes.
limitations: Current snapshot retrospective mapping includes later source changes
Current issue bodies may have edits after fix
Closing issue references can include features
Only fixes mapping to 1-8 current functions qualify
